Active Participation: We require staff members who can actively engage with the server and its members on a regular basis. This includes being present in voice/text channels, responding to questions, and actively monitoring server activity.

description: Server announcement from TheySixRole TheySix on 2024-10-03

body.text:
Guys I want to share something with you all recently @Mister Fish  made 2 amazing mods, I used the mods specifically the twin session which was incredible and I loved it, the twin session which I used for 1 week if I want to give you all a simple perspective imagine you can start the new client (a new player game screen) and you will be able to use it to afk at farms or even testing the most important thing about twin session is that you have full control over the client like default you start the game and you can just switch to the second client, about performance I tested this on my laptop which it has i7 10750 to get a final result it won't cause that much loading since you already loaded the chunks before but if you move around like new chunks with both clients (this is a rare case why you need to control both clients at once?! ) it will cause some lags but in total it works perfectly fine without any lags I wanted to share this masterpiece with you all!
Offline players: https://modrinth.com/mod/offlineplayers
This mod allows players to go AFK on a server without leaving their computers on. Simply use the /offline command to spawn an exact copy of your player, called an offline player. Depending on the configuration, you'll be kicked after the offline player has spawned.
If the offline player is killed, it won't drop loot but will be kicked from the server. When you rejoin, the inventory and XP levels from the offline player are copied to you, and you'll be killed. This gives you time to retrieve your items.
If the offline player survives until you rejoin, its inventory and gained experience will be transferred to you.
twin session: https://modrinth.com/mod/twinsession
The Fabric TwinSession mod enables players to connect to a Minecraft server multiple times using the same account.
This functionality is particularly useful for those who want the advantages of multiple sessions, such as managing different in-game tasks simultaneously, without needing to purchase additional Minecraft accounts. When a player connects to the server with the same account for the second time, the mod automatically modifies the player’s username by adding a numerical prefix followed by an underscore (e.g., "1_PlayerName").
Modrinth
OfflinePlayers - Minecraft Mod
Enable AFK mode without keeping your computer on. Use /offline to spawn a copy of your player. If your offline player dies, you'll die but still have time to retrieve your stuff. If the offline player survives, you'll inherit its gains upon return.
Modrinth
TwinSession - Minecraft Mod
TwinSession allows multiple connections from the same Minecraft account to a single server or world. Seamlessly manage multiple in-game tasks with different clients, all using one account, without disconnections or additional purchases.

description: Server announcement from LOA | catrooperRole Manager on 2025-12-07

body.text:
Major Announcement
Over the past month, the management and staff team of the Theysix discord server has been working hard to bring something big to you all.
Around a month ago, Theysix informed us of a sponsor for a minecraft server. Over the past month, we have been developing, and working hard to design, and bring interesting ideas to the server.
As of right now, we intend to use the server for solely events related purposes. We have come up with many ideas for the server, but as of right now, we intend to go with a hunger games style event. Which may be taking player applications soon, once the management team decides on it.
For clarity, we intend to launch the server a few days before Christmas.
However, we are still ironing out some bugs for both the Java and Bedrock  sides of the server, and working to fix the staff prefixes, in order to give each staff role their respective permissions.
If the server does well enough during our events, we may push for an additional survival server running 24/7, but nothing can be guaranteed as of now.
As of right now, there will not be any paid functions on the server, but cannot see the future, and where it may lead the server.
If you have not realized yet, the server is compatible for both Java and Bedrock
One last thing, one huge thank you to Sparked Hosting for sponsoring our server, and making it all happen!
Thank you all for your support!
A small sneak-peek of the server is attached below!

Huge thanks to SparkedHost for partnering with theysix team. Thanks to their support, we’ve got a solid, high performance server t…
description: Server announcement from TheySixRole TheySix on 2025-12-27

body.text:
We’re excited to announce our Event Server, launching 28 December! 🎉
Huge thanks to SparkedHost for partnering with theysix team. Thanks to their support, we’ve got a solid, high performance server that can easily handle big events and if everything goes well, we’re seriously considering turning it into a full time survival server after the holidays.
Starting on 28 December, we’ll open applications and share a link. You’ll submit your in game username, and we’ll randomly select players to fill the limited slots.
Submit your username via this link and make sure to put your username correctly!
Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdHGvqN1K7kPsWpoZ9FuTTj3O9AaZb4jR13x3OD91N_hcy87Q/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=117525335524848885141
Player sizes: there will be 4 teams matches with 100 ~ 200 players (Size of each team is 1 ~ 50 Depending on number of players )
Game modes: 4 Teams should capture center of the map while holding it, the last team will be winner
Random player selection: Slots will be filled randomly so everyone has a fair chance to get in
Maps: One large map
Game Type: Both Java & Bedrock are supported!
These events will mainly run on North American local times, but EU and Asia players are absolutely welcome our testing shows the ping is very solid, so don’t worry about that.
More info (exact schedule, and mode details) will be announced as we get closer to launch stay tuned and get ready for the event! 🎄✨
🎁 Holiday Event Rewards
To make this holiday event even more exciting, we’re adding special rewards for the best players:
🏅 Top Players
The Top players will receive an exclusive custom Discord role.
This role grants access to private sections of the server, where you’ll get closer contact with the staff, early info, and special event news.
TheySix Team 🎄✨
EVENT
Please put your in game username, ( bedrock, or java ) inside the box. ( MAKE SURE TO PUT YOUR NAME CORRECTLY INSIDE THE BOX )
